title: Daawwattoota Ajaa'ibaa Magaalaa Dallaa Qabdu
intro: Gareen tokko karra magaalaa sabni ishee dhugaa beekee hin beekne tokkoo gahe. Ergaa fidanii dhufan, jiraattonni garuu diinummaatti jijjiiramanii jeequmsa doorsisaa turan. Taʼus, bakka hin eegamne irraa sagalee tokkotu namoota hin beekne sana ittisuuf ol kaʼee, wanta jijjiirama guddaa akka qabaatu waltajjii mijeesse.
clues: Magaalaa ummanni ishee kufriidhaan liqimfame seenne.
Isaanis shakkiidhaan nu ilaalanii, 'Isin akka keenyaa uumama idilee qofa' jedhan.
Nuti isaan akeekkachiifne, isaan garuu dhagaa nurratti kaasan.
Namni tokko dhugaa keenya mirkaneessuuf fiixee magaalattii isa fagoo irraa ariifate.
Innis saba isaatiif, ‘Maaliif isa na uume sana hin sagadu?’ jedhee labse.
Haaluun magaalattii dhohinsa tokkoon xumurame, bakka yeroo tokko itti qoosanitti callisni moo'ate.

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Ibiddi qabbanaa'ee fi nageenya qabu ta'e
Iddoon biqiltuu sun ibidda samiitiin gubate
Whale nama sana gara qarqara galaanaatti deebise

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
